one_sentence_story: A single source record enters a transparent Context Capsule, becomes a traversable torus-world with a hexagonal cusp, and returns as a bounded S6 paper claim with its receipt and falsifier attached.
evidence_boundary: The reference image supplies visual grammar only; it is not operational evidence. The S6 statement is shown as a paper claim, not as consensus fact.

beats.title: Ask at the source
beats.visual: On a black field, one warm paper card stands on a dark hexagonal world tile. Readable text: SOURCE LOG and one source pointer. One amber claim seed is outside the card.
beats.caption: Can a record be a place you can enter?
beats.causal_move: The question attaches the claim seed to one named source record.

beats.title: Carry the record
beats.visual: The amber claim seed travels along one luminous evidence stream from the source card into a transparent rectangular Context Capsule at center. Source card, label, and world tile remain unchanged.
beats.caption: First, keep the record attached to the move.
beats.causal_move: The claim becomes admissible only by carrying its source pointer into the capsule.

beats.title: Make the place
beats.visual: Inside the capsule, the seed unfolds into three stable cyan torus rings. One hexagonal fibre grows from the rings and ends in a cusp. No dashboard, counters, or extra symbols enter.
beats.caption: If memory is a world, the record must have a traversable shape.
beats.causal_move: The stored record is rendered as a world-form rather than as a separate map icon.

beats.title: Touch the trace
beats.visual: The cusp fibre crosses the capsule boundary and touches the original hexagonal world tile. The tile opens into a short WORLD TRACE label and one receipt marker; all other geometry freezes.
beats.caption: The world trace is the receipt of where the record can be visited.
beats.causal_move: The cusp links the transformed record back to one concrete world trace.

beats.title: Close, but leave a way out
beats.visual: The amber stream completes a loop from source card through capsule, torus family, cusp, and world trace back to a final claim card. It reads S6 PAPER CLAIM, RECORD = TERRAIN, NOT CONSENSUS. A red open notch labelled FALSIFIER remains visible.
beats.caption: S6 paper claim: the record is the terrain. This film does not prove it; a missing trace or broken traversal would refute this form.
beats.causal_move: The claim closes only with both a receipt/world trace and an explicit falsifier route.

manim_plan.render: Use a fixed orthographic camera, black background, fixed camera center (0,0,0), and no random particle system. Seed all color and point lists from worker=38.
scene_graph: Create world_trace as one six-sided Polygon centered at (-4.9,-2.0,0); reuse its object identity across all beats.
Create context_capsule as a fixed-width translucent RectangleGroup centered at (0,0,0).
Create torus_family with ParametricSurface major radii [1.35,1.65,1.95], minor radius 0.06, and fixed rotations [0,PI/6,-PI/6].
Create cusp_fibre as one Polyline with six points forming a hexagonal cusp; attach its first point to the torus center.
Create one amber claim_seed Diamond and move that same object along four fixed cubic Bezier segments.
Create falsifier_port as a red V-shaped notch and keep it hidden until beat 5.
timing: Beat 1: FadeIn(source_card, world_trace), then Write(question) over 42 frames.
Beat 2: MoveAlongPath(claim_seed, source_to_capsule_path, 42 frames); no other object moves.
Beat 3: Transform(claim_seed, torus_family, 36 frames), then Create(cusp_fibre, 24 frames).
Beat 4: MoveAlongPath(cusp_fibre, capsule_to_trace_path, 36 frames); freeze all rings while the trace label is written.
Beat 5: Create(loop_path, 30 frames), Write(final_claim_and_not_consensus, 36 frames), then FadeIn(falsifier_port) and hold 30 frames.
verification_hooks: Assert exactly 5 beats and exactly one moving primary object per beat.
Assert every visible text string is in the caption_script or the fixed labels SOURCE LOG, WORLD TRACE, S6 PAPER CLAIM, NOT CONSENSUS, FALSIFIER.
Assert no particle emitter, dashboard panel, counter, or unlabelled symbol is instantiated.
Assert final frame contains source_card, context_capsule, torus_family, world_trace, receipt marker, and falsifier_port.

falsifier.test: Run a source-pinned traversal test: if the record can be traversed while the visited world place is absent from the record, or if a recorded place has no reachable world trace, the literal claim RECORD = TERRAIN is refuted for that sample.
falsifier.paper_status: This is a proposed falsifier for a paper claim; it is not a report that the test has been run.
